name: array_test.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((ArrayBasicTest (mk-ArrayBasicTest (arr (Array Int Int))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-ArrayBasicTest (sel-ArrayBasicTest ArrayBasicTest))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-ArrayBasicTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ArrayBasicTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ArrayBasicTest ((this Ref)) ArrayBasicTest
  (sel-ArrayBasicTest (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-ArrayBasicTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ArrayBasicTest this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------
;   Getters for class ArrayBasicTest:
; -------------------------------------

; --- getters for ArrayBasicTest.arr: ---

(define-fun ArrayBasicTest!arr ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (arr (deref-ArrayBasicTest this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ArrayBasicTest:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-ArrayBasicTest ArrayBasicTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ArrayBasicTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayBasicTest!arr this) 0) 42)
)

(assert (! (ArrayBasicTest.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ArrayBasicTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayBasicTest!arr this) 1) 100)
)

(assert (! (ArrayBasicTest.inv2 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun ArrayBasicTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayBasicTest!arr this) 2) (+ (select (ArrayBasicTest!arr this) 0) (select (ArrayBasicTest!arr this) 1)))
)

(assert (! (ArrayBasicTest.inv3 1) :named _xkassert2))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-ArrayBasicTest const-1-ArrayBasicTest))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-ArrayBasicTest () ArrayBasicTest
  (mk-ArrayBasicTest (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 100) 0 42) 2 142)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (arr (sel-ArrayBasicTest (select heap 1))) 2))
      (a!2 (select (arr (sel-ArrayBasicTest (select heap 1))) 0))
      (a!3 (select (arr (sel-ArrayBasicTest (select heap 1))) 1)))
  (= a!1 (+ a!2 a!3))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (arr (sel-ArrayBasicTest (select heap 1))) 1)))
  (= a!1 100)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (arr (sel-ArrayBasicTest (select heap 1))) 0)))
  (= a!1 42)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (mk-ArrayBasicTest
             (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 100) 0 42) 2 142))))
  (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 1 (lift-ArrayBasicTest a!1))))
